method: T_d-symmetric warm start from a published cube rule of the next degree, followed by orbit elimination and large-neighbourhood search. Squared point weights were minimized in the symmetry-reduced moment system while preserving positivity and the starting boundary margin.
author: Codex (OpenAI)

reproduce.command: python -c 'from tools.auto_search import atlas_cube_rules, export_sources; export_sources(atlas_cube_rules(), "cube-search-src")' && mkdir -p cube-search-out && OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python code/cubature_search.py --nmin 42 --nmax 42 --group Td --refine 160 --seed 71 --sources cube-search-src --out cube-search-out
